# Link Prospecting Tool

The Apify actor [`apify/link-prospecting-tool`](https://apify.com/apify/link-prospecting-tool) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.14**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Monitor your brand visibility across AI and organic search platforms (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity). Check if quoted sources include your brand, and find link outreach opportunities.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/link-prospecting-tool) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-link-prospecting-tool@0.0.14#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      queries: "…"
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queries` | string | yes |  | Search queries — Enter one search query per line. These queries will be sent to the enabled AI platforms (ChatGPT, Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, and Perplexity) to check for your brand's visibility. |
| `brand` | string | yes |  | Brand name — The brand name to search for in AI-generated responses and cited sources. The search is case-insensitive. |
| `organicResult` | integer |  | `10` | Organic results to include — How many organic search results to include per query. Asking for more than 10 will slow down the Actor. |
| `enableChatGpt` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable ChatGPT Search — Enable ChatGPT Search to get AI-generated answers from OpenAI's search model. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor. |
| `enableAiMode` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable Google AI Mode — Enable Google AI Mode to get Google's AI-generated responses. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor. |
| `enableAiOverviews` | boolean |  | `true` | Process Google AI Overviews — Process Google AI Overviews that appear in search results. No additional cost - the Actor will analyze the AI Overview content and sources for brand mentions. |
| `enablePerplexity` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable Perplexity AI Search — Enable Perplexity AI to get answers from the Sonar model. Additional fees apply per successful result via the Google Search Scraper Actor. |
| `enableGemini` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable Gemini AI Search — Fetches an AI answer from Gemini (gemini.google.com) for every query to compare against other AI platforms. |
| `enableCopilot` | boolean |  | `true` | Enable Copilot AI Search — Fetches an AI answer from Copilot for every query to compare against other AI models. |
| `ownDomains` | string[] |  | `[]` | Own domains (to exclude) — List your own domains to exclude from source analysis. Sources from these domains will be skipped since you already have presence there. |
| `competitorDomains` | string[] |  | `[]` | Competitor domains (to exclude) — List competitor domains to exclude from source analysis. Sources from these domains will be skipped. |
| `ignoreDomains` | string[] |  | `[]` | Other domains to exclude — List competitor domains to exclude. For example domain with user generated content like Quora and Youtube |
| `maxContactsPerDomain` | integer |  | `1` | Max contacts per domain — Maximum number of contact leads to scrape from each source domain where the brand isn't mentioned. Higher values increase cost but provide more outreach contacts. |
| `includeMention` | boolean |  | `true` | Include mentions without backlink — By default, sources that mention your brand without giving you a backlink are included in the contact search. |
| `department` | string[] |  | `["marketing","c_suite"]` | Department to search for leads — By default, the Actor looks for leads in the marketing department, as they're most likely to work on link building. |
| `enableEmailVerification` | boolean |  | `true` | Email verification — When enabled, verifies the email address of each lead extracted during business leads enrichment. Each lead receives an emailVerification object with the verification result and quality assessment. |
| `searchAuthorName` | boolean |  | `false` | Search for author name — Uses AI to identify the author of the article and find their email address. |

## Output

The actor publishes no dataset schema, so `items` are untyped objects.
